subject: modules/canopy/projection/reconcile_lcs_benchmark_wbtest.mbt
purpose: Pre-extraction baseline for the three reconcile workloads (Phase 2 of docs/plans/2026-08-08-core-reconcile-engine-deepening.md, issue #1196). Recorded BEFORE any engine extraction so Phase 3 can be judged against these numbers. No timing thresholds are asserted — this is BAND 2b evidence, not a gate.

observedAt.canopy: refactor/redesign-scratch @ 049a7f09 (engine untouched; Phase 1 characterization tests committed)

executedProbes.hardware: same host as the 2026-08-08 session; single run per bench (variance shown as mean ± σ over 10 iterations each)

workloads.positional fast path: two N-def Modules, positionally identical kinds, equal length — the fast path skips the O(m×n) LCS table
workloads.forced LCS fallback: same lists with one Int-typed child spliced at the middle — rejects the positional shortcut, reaches the quadratic DP
workloads.exact-key: reconcile_with_exact_key with kind_tag as key — fingerprint maps for both trees plus the weighted suffix DP

instrumentControl.why: A bench that never reaches its intended code path records meaningless numbers.
instrumentControl.observed: control: fallback workload reaches the LCS DP table (Inserted trace event present, spliced node fresh) — passes; the fast-path control pins N+1-wide children at every benched size.
instrumentControl.conclusion: Each workload exercises the path it claims to measure.

findings.note: Linear in sibling count; the fast path avoids the quadratic table.
Quadratic as expected; 1000-def fallback is ~44× the fast path at the same width. The unified engine must keep the fast-path branch.
Fingerprinting dominates: ~5× the fallback at 1000 defs. Reconcile_with_exact_key is the JSX streaming path.

executedProbes.regressionRule: Phase 3 must keep the positional fast path within the B1 band (order-of-magnitude check, not a threshold gate); fallback and exact-key numbers are recorded for comparison, not enforcement.
